description: This file contains the implementation of the DateTimeHelperService class, which provides various date and time utility methods such as formatting dates, comparing dates, calculating date differences, generating date ranges, and retrieving week boundaries. It is part of the OrangeHRM core service layer.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperService
classes.description: Provides helper methods for handling, formatting, and calculating with DateTime objects, including timezone handling, date comparisons, and week boundary calculations.

methods.name: getDateFormatter
methods.description: Returns an instance of LocalizedDateFormatter, instantiating it if not already created.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object to a 'Y-m-d' string or returns null if null is provided.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object to a time string in 'H:i' or 'H:i:s' format.

methods.name: convertSecondsToTimeString
methods.description: Converts seconds into a 'H:i' or 'H:i:s' formatted string.

methods.name: isDatesEqual
methods.description: Checks if two DateTime objects have the same date, optionally accepting null values.

methods.name: dateDiffInHours
methods.description: Calculates difference in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: dateRange
methods.description: Generates a list of DateTime objects between two dates based on a specified interval.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns the current date and time, optionally in a specified timezone.

methods.name: getNowInUTC
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in UTC timezone.

methods.name: getTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeZone object based on a timezone offset in hours.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string based on system config or default format.

methods.name: getWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the week for a given date, based on an adjustable start day.
